scenarios.name: Launch a main-panel command while its expansion is open

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon shows the Modify panel
the unpinned Modify additional command area is open
the user clicks Shell in the main Modify panel
the Shell properties panel opens with a preview in the viewport
the Modify additional command area remains visible in the captured state
the user clicks Cancel in the Shell properties panel
the properties panel and preview close
the Modify additional command area is no longer visible
